description.text: Postsecondary psychology teachers prepare and deliver lessons, lead discussion, grade, and update psychology knowledge. See O*NET 25-1066 tasks, US 2025 wages, BLS 2025–2035 projections, and the postsecondary position boundaries.

subject.name: Postsecondary Psychology Teachers
subject.summary: Postsecondary psychology teachers teach psychology courses such as developmental, clinical, cognitive, or counseling psychology, prepare and deliver lessons, organize discussion and laboratory activities, evaluate student assignments and papers, and keep their subject knowledge current; a position may emphasize teaching or combine teaching with research. Postsecondary teaching duties do not automatically grant clinical diagnostic and treatment authority.
